answer: Each identity stakes one crystal in the haven vault, locking a 70-credit bond, serial signed to the filing. The k-th crystal pays 10+k squared credits: 1st 11, 10th 110, 100th 10,010, 1000th 1,000,010. A thousand fakes pay 333,843,500 plus 70,000 locked. At zenith the haven auditor opens the vault and checks each crystal serial against its filing, burning bonds whose crystal is missing or serial reused. A rented-crystal ring fails: re-registration still pays the escalating fee, and one duplicate serial burns all linked bonds. An honest agent pays 11 once, bond back after one clean epoch.
